headline: Lead Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure
page_title: Rajendra P N - Lead Platform Engineer
summary_html: Lead Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, developer enablement, and production reliability. Builds Azure landing-zone foundations, modular Terraform, GitHub Actions golden paths, and AKS/GitOps delivery. Automates provisioning and operations with PowerShell, Python, and Bash; integrates policy, managed identities, Key Vault, and security validation into platform workflows. Improves service visibility with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights while supporting resilient application, data, and AI/ML infrastructure, cost governance, and engineering collaboration.

skill_sections.title: Azure Landing Zones & IaC
skill_sections.content: Terraform modules, Azure Storage remote state, state locking, plan reviews, Azure Policy, managed identities, Key Vault, GitOps; env zero governance concepts; legacy Blueprints and deployment-stack migration concepts

skill_sections.title: GitHub & Developer Productivity
skill_sections.content: GitHub Actions reusable YAML workflows, repositories, Packages/GHCR, artifacts, Environments, approvals, protected branches, CODEOWNERS, OIDC, golden paths for application/data/ML delivery

skill_sections.title: Containers, Networking & GitOps
skill_sections.content: Docker, AKS, ACR, Helm, Argo CD; hub/spoke, Private Link, VNET integration, DNS, TLS/certificates; WAF, Application Gateway, Firewall, ExpressRoute/VPN concepts

skill_sections.title: DevSecOps & Supply Chain
skill_sections.content: SAST/DAST, secret/container/IaC scanning, GitHub Advanced Security, CodeQL, Dependabot, SBOM, OPA/Conftest, policy-as-code, admission controls; Defender for Cloud and Cosign signing concepts

skill_sections.title: Observability, Reliability & Cost
skill_sections.content: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics/KQL, Application Insights, alerts/dashboards, blameless postmortems, runbooks, autoscaling, resiliency testing; chaos experiment design, tags, budgets, rightsizing

skill_sections.title: Automation, AI & Data Platforms
skill_sections.content: PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, REST APIs; Kubernetes infrastructure for Milvus and GPU services; Azure ML/OpenAI, model registries, feature stores, prompt guardrails, Databricks, Synapse, Purview, Event Hubs/Service Bus concepts

skill_sections.title: Governance & Engineering Leadership
skill_sections.content: Design/PR reviews, roadmap planning, tool evaluations, mentoring, documentation, audit evidence; healthcare security knowledge: HIPAA/HITRUST control concepts, PHI handling, access restrictions and data governance

achievements.text: Standardized Terraform modules and platform configuration for Azure networking, identity, secrets, compute, and Kubernetes delivery.
Built reusable workflows, protected release environments, and artifact promotion patterns to support consistent developer delivery.
Integrated security validation, Azure telemetry, incident runbooks, and infrastructure reviews into shared platform workflows.

experience.title: Lead Platform/DevOps Engineer
impact: Built Azure landing-zone foundations with modular Terraform for networking, identity, storage, and AKS, standardizing parameters and reviewed infrastructure changes.
Managed Terraform remote state in Azure Storage with state locking and environment isolation; integrated policy checks and approval gates into infrastructure delivery.
Developed reusable GitHub Actions workflows for application and infrastructure releases, combining tests, artifact promotion, protected Environments, and quality gates.
Standardized GitHub repository policies, Packages/GHCR consumption, branch protection, and OIDC cloud access to improve developer self-service and release traceability.
Applied Azure Policy, managed identities, and Key Vault controls; integrated IaC, secret, dependency, and container checks into shared platform workflows.
Operated AKS with Helm and Argo CD, maintaining deployment health checks, workload identity, private service access, autoscaling, and recovery procedures.
Implemented Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights visibility; led incident triage, blameless reviews, and runbook improvements with application teams.
Supported Milvus and GPU-enabled services across Azure/AWS infrastructure; reviewed resource utilization, tagging, and capacity to improve AI workload readiness and cost visibility.
Reviewed platform designs and PRs, mentored engineers, and partnered with infrastructure leaders on standards, roadmap priorities, and vendor/tool evaluations.
Automated deployment concurrency and smoke-test checks in GitHub Actions, preventing overlapping environment updates and capturing verification evidence for release decisions.
Automated environment prerequisite checks for DNS resolution, service endpoints, and required configuration, catching deployment blockers before release execution.
Created reusable Python diagnostics to collect workload status and recent failures, giving developers consistent evidence for application troubleshooting.
Reviewed container resource requests and deployment settings with service owners, addressing capacity constraints and unstable application startup behavior.
Maintained release recovery checklists and verified rollback inputs in nonproduction environments, improving readiness for failed application deployments.
Published platform onboarding examples and troubleshooting documentation, helping application teams adopt shared pipelines and resolve common configuration issues.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
impact: Partnered with application teams to troubleshoot Azure/AWS delivery and implement reusable GitHub Actions workflows for builds, tests, and release promotion.
Maintained Linux/Windows GitHub runners and shared build tooling, diagnosing dependency, cache, credential, and execution-capacity failures.
Standardized GitHub repositories, protected branches, environment approvals, and artifact retention to support consistent delivery standards.
Standardized Docker images, Kubernetes deployment patterns, branch protections, and image-validation checks to make releases easier for developers to troubleshoot.
Organized artifact feeds and repository consumption patterns and coached engineers on merge workflows, pipeline ownership, and environment promotion.
Maintained Terraform configuration and Ansible automation for Azure environment setup, reviewing deployment plans and Linux configuration drift.
Maintained Helm deployment defaults and environment values for shared Kubernetes services, validating application health and recovery during release promotion.
Automated runner readiness and deployment diagnostics with Python and shell scripts, publishing troubleshooting utilities for application teams.
Protected deployment inputs with Key Vault and least-privilege service connections; validated required checks and documented release handoffs.
Validated reusable workflow changes in isolated test jobs, checking input contracts, artifact paths, and environment settings before adoption by application teams.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer II

Improved service visibility with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights; partnered with developers on incidents and recovery documentation.
Reviewed infrastructure security, naming, and tagging with application owners, validating policy checks and platform dependencies before promotion.
Diagnosed Kubernetes scheduling, image-pull, and service-connectivity failures, correlating workload events with cloud telemetry to restore reliable delivery.
Developed Python and shell checks for infrastructure dependencies and release verification, improving consistent execution across Azure environments.
Coordinated AKS node maintenance and application upgrades, verifying workload readiness and recovery steps with service owners before production changes.

Developed Groovy Jenkins shared libraries for image versioning and artifact publishing, allowing developers to reuse tested pipeline steps across services.

Partnered with microservice developers on build dependencies, unit and integration test stages, test-result publication, and repeatable promotion of release artifacts.
Provisioned Azure application infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, maintaining AWS integrations and environment-specific release configuration.
Standardized Docker/Helm deployment patterns for AKS services and payment workloads, validating configuration, health checks, and production readiness.

Maintained reusable deployment guidance and GitHub workflow conventions, coaching developers on release controls and shared platform capabilities.
Managed artifact retention and dependency access for shared delivery services, troubleshooting repository failures and preserving approved build inputs for recovery.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer

Validated environment readiness and application dependencies before deployments, checking cloud access, network connectivity, and required configuration.

Captured deployment manifests and configuration baselines for environment handoffs, helping support teams trace runtime failures to source or release changes.
